$description: Neutral UX-mode defaults for density, type scale, motion, feedback and focus emphasis. UX modes must redefine every one of these.

target-size.$description: Minimum interactive target. Never below 24px (WCAG 2.2 AA, 2.5.8); the build enforces it.

gap-scale.$description: Multiplier for gaps; apply as calc(var(--idg-space-m) * var(--idg-density-gap-scale)).

type-scale.$description: Multiplier for the type scale; apply as calc(var(--idg-font-size-step-0) * var(--idg-ux-type-scale)).

hints.$description: 1 shows helper and hint affordances by default, 0 hides them.

shortcuts.$description: 1 shows keyboard shortcut hints, 0 hides them.

enabled.$description: 1 allows movement; 0 means fades only. Reduced-motion preferences force 0.

hover-lift.$description: Distance a control rises on hover; apply with translateY(calc(var(--idg-feedback-hover-lift) * -1)).

press-scale.$description: Scale of a control while pressed; 1 means no squash.

emphasis.$description: Multiplier for the focus ring width; apply as calc(var(--idg-focus-ring-width) * var(--idg-focus-emphasis)).
